[{"Name":"Mauro Carraro","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW7ZY3JTB7dm5nrV8mV8gSPY7VA4ud1JVeZw3M0vURu3meatvU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Not your ordinary Maroccan fare. Their farm to fork policy is genuine and of superior quality to anywhere else I’ve eaten in Marrakesh. The resulting dishes were thoughtful and had so many flavours. Don’t go there if you are expecting cous cous and tagines. Go if you are looking to reward your tastebuds. Can’t fault it, service impeccable staff attentive and full of atmosphere. Loved it 🙏","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDQNMklsWbmUNVXt36FojJg&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2026-1-23"},{"Name":"Rivan Hannika","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUbW2vCOQIwnXC-eEUoB_bKc1339sr9uT0iIR7DnDfztvL3_PhG=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I was here to celebrate the birthday of my partner and everyone at this establishment made it more than perfect. Not only was the food outstandingly good, the staff was incredibly accommodating and made sure our wishes were fulfilled. Waqil did an amazing job with his recommendations on the food and wine and when desert came around we had the entire restaurant singing happy birthday to us. I can’t stress the amount of joy we had this evening and would recommend anyone who visits Marrakech to eat at Farmers.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhADMhjPHk59ez42mkVHkmaS&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2026-1-19"},{"Name":"Paul Murashe","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXcDRO5FDR3ZuQDzvlsMG1HMnx9EHbc_WiIR-5uUgc9jfzSn7I=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"WOW. Farmers is by far the best restaurant I have experienced in the last few years of coming to Marrakesh. It's a 10 across the board for food, atmosphere, drinks, and the impeccable, knowledgeable, personal, and friendly service. You must try the leeks, battered monkfish, squash with arugula and leave space for the chocolate mousse, total bliss. Congratulations.
I long to come back and dine again. Until next time.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBKuzFuBokm02XxVOl0M1eZ&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2026-2-19"},{"Name":"Cenk Turkinan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWqmu7oOY4xRJW8TjBzUwXYk6h5769t8LATbN9_si2IJt8pkSif=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Simply amazing. I was expecting it to be very good. It was beyond. Creative and exquisitely prepared local food and local Moroccan wine from Berkane region were excellent. The spices, local vegetables and local sea bream were special. Service warm and attentive to detail. Tasting menu is the best gateway to explosion of tastes.  Thank you Ugne and Mustapha.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCjT9RhD9UR0LOLWNnioNHg&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2025-12-29"},{"Name":"Salwa L","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWMewUmcaLwW-ttr3G40duIc-L6Ro6vmvVxr8uz6t7ERpMaQkdZtQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I wouldn’t be exaggerating if I said this is my favorite restaurant in all of Morocco. As an avid foodie and traveler who makes food the focal point of my life, I’m often disappointed by cookie-cutter restaurants in Morocco that focus more on presentation than actual flavor. I was ecstatic when I saw this restaurant featured in Time magazine and knew I had to try it.

It’s a small, charming place decorated with so much intent and care. Everything is farm-to-table and absolutely delicious- truly worthy of a Michelin star. The chef is a young Moroccan talent who makes me so proud, and to top it all off, they serve some of the best cocktails I’ve had anywhere in Morocco.

They’ll definitely be seeing me often. I want to eat what I already had again and also try everything else on the menu. My only concern was the little cat that snooped in toward the end of dinner , as someone with a serious cat phobia, that gave me a mini heart attack, lol. But apparently, he’s the master of the building. Great job to the whole team, keep up the amazing work, so proud.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA792o5tvanl71l7VDJeD9w&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2025-11-5"},{"Name":"Hilel Bistre","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVjJ7_6A_6aM2wjZmXdOrVbSEbzBBnT6KN37mbo3ujKS5e4E1--tg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Great surprise to find this place. The food it's from great sources, including their own, and all the plates are greatly thought and executed. Attention to the food in details it's truly apriciated and you find it here. Also service it's attentive, has good knowledge of their offeringa and not intrusive. I'll add it to my must visit list in marakesh","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhC_VbVSF4fqyO8DVpuHQ2n5&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2026-2-17"},{"Name":"Alissia W.","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIBD6A0nuYNAue_gUpqtvimRLtK4x-DnuZEIFOkqsAYOQdfvg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"By far our favorite restaurant in Marrakech - and honestly one of our top 5 in the world. Everything was outstanding: the food and drinks were exceptional, the service and staff were incredibly attentive and the atmosphere and interior design made the evening feel truly special. We loved every minute of our evening here - highly recommended!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhA93XfrrsDFzDF8MSDYOwb_&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2025-9-29"},{"Name":"Melani Wilson","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJkLRWD2ZtfZrfqklVjqkuYkJLAmlE0NW3c8mSm75juMbpB9w=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We could not have been more delighted with our recent meal at Farmers.  The entire complex is so interesting and thoughtfully done.  The restaurant itself was stylish yet comfortable and the staff attentive, knowledgeable and professional.    Add that to amazing food (dare I say the best I’ve had in the city?) and a creative cocktail menu (yes I had a Farmers Dirty Martini at lunch!), and you have an experience worth tracking down. Kudos to all for making this beautiful spot come to life!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAGU2fizxZxKfnmsEahbCyN&fid=0x0:0x4dc9d12a5906415"],"When":"2025-9-11"}]

From the moment we walked in, the restaurant delivered an exceptional fine-dining experience. Every dish was beautifully executed—rich in flavor, artfully presented, and thoughtfully balanced. The menu shows real culinary mastery, with each course offering something memorable. The ingredients tasted incredibly fresh, and the pacing of the meal was perfect.

The cocktails were another highlight. Creative without being over-the-top, they were well-crafted and perfectly matched to the dishes. You can tell the bar team takes real pride in their craft; each drink had depth, balance, and personality.

A special note of appreciation for our waiter, Reda, who truly elevated the evening. His service was impeccable—attentive but never intrusive, warm and professional. Reda offered excellent recommendations, answered every question with genuine enthusiasm, and made sure every detail was perfect. His timing, hospitality, and sense of care made the experience feel effortlessly smooth.

Overall, a remarkable restaurant with outstanding food, exceptional drinks, and world-class service. We’ll definitely be returning—and we’ll be asking for Reda!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhChR26nIeEH8EXOODX3RsOI&fid=0x0:0x681412f415df9b85"],"When":"2025-11-21"},{"Name":"teresa ohrner","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXCgSRLXcISr_2dYRT1orFtDxH4bFoPbNedYDZ3VnZmIHHMbwt9=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"It was very good, the ambient was absolutely amazing!!! I went with my friends and we had a very good time. The food was amazing, we ordered different dishes and all of them were delicious, the service was kind, The waiter Reda was so nice and the ambiance was just perfect, we went early just for dinner and an artist started singing with a guitar and playing good and known songs in different languages and it was amazing! we loved it. We visited a lot of places and this was the best one so far!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD-mBX_fBDRMKapUWBJPJBu&fid=0x0:0x681412f415df9b85"],"When":"2026-2-18"},{"Name":"Chris Pendlebury","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXCWNw4tsqOmp0xgM0QCJa2BAH8OUP15lgaDW1j0xXHx2sFHv4rJQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"A flawless evening at Leopard Restaurant — with impeccable service from Réda!

From the moment we arrived, Leopard Restaurant delivered a refined and deeply welcoming experience. The seafood was exceptional the Moroccan oysters were very fresh, the pil pil shrimp perfectly spiced, and the Oysters with gratin and salmon were very nice. The lamb shoulder was a triumph though, tender, aromatic, and beautifully presented.

But what truly elevated the evening was our waiter, Redà. His attentiveness, warmth, and understanding of our needs made us feel not just served, but genuinely cared for. Redà brought a personal touch that turned a great meal into a memorable occasion.

Every dish was timed to perfection, the wine selection was spot-on tried some Moroccan white, and has a white and red Port, the general design and ambiance in the restaurant was a nice balance between elegance and comfort. Highly recommend for anyone seeking a standout dining experience in Marrakesh.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBmIXyzG708iRf41nE1CFfj&fid=0x0:0x681412f415df9b85"],"When":"2025-10-15"},{"Name":"MAX MAX","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJv64tjSD6LxLCMQ6BlBGa0MCdz03hpyyIKujsulmFRkaZCng=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Leopard was great venue, had a issue when we booked it originally when we were told we all had to eat the same food. I guess this was due to all the entertainment provided so the cost has to be paid. The service was exceptional from KARIM, he really tried hard to make it a memorable event so thank you from all of us. The establishment needs to recognise this.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDe_TH6cGvXbUZ_onWBWfrP&fid=0x0:0x681412f415df9b85"],"When":"2025-11-25"},{"Name":"Daan Van nispen","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLAH7LnT--s3vgzaxN1j-cXXUcRN4sRMDQsW6glSr-VGxtWtQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our experience at Leopard was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we walked in, everything exuded class, refinement, and attention to detail. Leopard is truly a high-class restaurant in every sense of the word — the kind of place where quality, atmosphere, and service come together flawlessly.
A very special mention must go to Oussama, our host and server. He is, without exaggeration, one of the best hosts we have ever had. His service was sincere, warm, professional, and perfectly balanced — attentive without being intrusive. You could genuinely feel his passion for hospitality, and he made us feel not just welcomed, but truly valued as guests.
Oussama elevated the entire experience and represents exactly what top-tier service should look like. Thanks to him and the outstanding quality of the restaurant, this evening will stay with us for a long time.
Leopard sets the standard. Highly recommended.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDrSSmYU0ZE5rJavBjX5O-I&fid=0x0:0x681412f415df9b85"],"When":"2026-2-1"}]

Came to Beldi everyday I was staying in Marrakech.

Once ordered, the food is quick to arrive.

I would recommend the pistachio cheesecake. One of the best I've ever had. Also, the mango juice is very good.

I would suggest a menu in English as well in order to improve service. In addition, staff should pay more attention to tables. Some of the days we were waiting almost 15 minutes just to get our order noted.

All the rest was great!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD6f5lwfTXmU_ERvQbasfGO&fid=0x0:0xee25278f61a43e31"],"When":"2026-3-5"},{"Name":"Ksenia Rapcun","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXNuphqHoq8zB9JcZTTICHz47i670RITsq2w-uepwOsX5S6xPvd=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We’ve been to Beldi Fusion Kitchen multiple times during our stay in Marrakech, and honestly, we just can’t stay away! The space itself is stunning … beautiful design that somehow manages to be both elegant and cozy at the same time. The music sets the perfect atmosphere.

And the food… absolutely incredible. Every dish we’ve tried has been heaven. We’ve been for both breakfast and dinner, and the quality is consistently amazing. What really surprised us is how affordable it is for such a gorgeous place with this level of quality.

The service deserves special mention. Everyone on the team is genuinely friendly and attentive… our food arrived quickly every time. And Ibtisaam! She’s the one who welcomes guests and makes sure everyone is seated and comfortable. Her warmth and smile make you feel like you’re visiting a friend. She truly sets the tone for the whole experience.

Can’t wait to come back next time we’re in Marrakech!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAy_t9HxO10BQvVR73c4zQl&fid=0x0:0xee25278f61a43e31"],"When":"2026-2-9"},{"Name":"Kirsty J","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLsEh06n19v8FHPut87vfNsvt1Yj1KsK7zkbIjjVcBUS3jFxw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I absolutely love Beldi Fusion Kitchen. The delivery orders are especially disappointing. On 2 occasions, I didn’t even touch the food and had to order something else instead. That was really frustrating.

I was genuinely happy when I first found a good Italian restaurant in Marrakech, but sadly, it looks like this place will no longer be on my list. I hope you improve the quality in the future!!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhD-KQi8Vrvs1XxJ02Ohsvig&fid=0x0:0xf397a8768bc95466"],"When":"2026-2-21"},{"Name":"Yasmine Ait boulbarod","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJGDPG7aU54DyG-iYTuMXHMavlf_c2Ijnmj3OftMtKq7EhtAA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"Very disappointing experience.

[{"Name":"Sam","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIF6ThgVurUSV8GTB0Yjf-sextIUcsBWuCYmOhCjugPac8hHA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"I enjoyed my meal but it could have been better. The prices are a lot more expensive compared to other similar quality restaurants, twice as much. It’s not worth it. Service was okay. Specials board only in French language. The air conditioning wasn’t working during my visit and it was uncomfortably warm inside, unpleasant. The snails were good although to be honest you couldn’t taste the meat because of all the sauce they were cooked in. Served “red hot”. The goats cheese salad was also good, but too big a starter for one person, could easily share for two. The steak was overcooked, I asked for medium but in my opinion I was served well done. The pepper sauce was wonderful, a “real kick” of flavours. Overall a nice restaurant if you’re willing to pay double…….and they have to fix the air conditioning!!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKENTI1JXDx9CE5AE&fid=0x0:0xa99fe1b8237211f6"],"When":"2025-5-26"},{"Name":"Chris Scott","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKY_JqWdYU1EoiKYzocPOvR3D0tlEvrrd4LvCLmSLPTfJY3Fw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We were lucky enough to choose this restaurant, one of many, on our last night in Marrakesh. This was primarily as it was on the same road as our hotel, and we had walked 22 miles in the previous 48 hours.
We were not disappointed.
Like many things here, this was very much a heavily French eatery. The food, especially my fillet steak with pepper sauce and h/m mash was absolutely amazing. We were surprised by the lack of customers when we went in just before 9, but it was filling up, with locals - a great sign, when we were leaving close to 11.
Our waiter, Rachid, was attentive, informative and funny, without being pushy. His attitude, the food, and the venue prompted us to give a near 40%  tip. That is, in all honesty, not something I usually do, but it was definitely worth it.
Highly recommended.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Jil","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX-u8gP88PV1XuzAx6zyawy4SzddeU08gdzeuoGad0Nu8520tU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I want to separately mention this restaurant. The interior is beautiful, with high shelves, part of the space on two floors, and the food and service are excellent. My avocado and shrimp salad, as well as the carpaccio, are very tasty! Given such presentation and interior, I would only change the glasses to more elegant ones, and use Peugeot salt and pepper, and brown sugar in a sugar bowl, not in a paper bag.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIC1v7q0jgE&fid=0x0:0xa99fe1b8237211f6"],"When":"2024-1-4"},{"Name":"Verena Sunday","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI1ixwLX5SE20sXEpuaTwB3jFgAt6SLOUzyFvN6gvaxPZQPnQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Fantastic French food in the heart of Marrakesh. We had the lamb shank, the salmon and the chicken with mushroom sauce. Everything was so good, we came back for a second time within a one week holiday in Marrakesh. Highly recommendable, great service on top, plus great ambiance.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMDwt46jlwE&fid=0x0:0xa99fe1b8237211f6"],"When":"2025-3-28"},{"Name":"Peter Lambrose","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIHF7AEoW9gnRmzEr7SDtQI0eCnOwmSdb9yf5_5vJlkG7t5CQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"I just stopped here because it looked nice and I was feeling peckish.

Inside it is nice, and they have a grand selection of pastries and tartlets. I do have to admit, I found it hard to decide which to choose.

After a few minutes checking out the options, I went for the chocolate cake. I can’t compare to other cakes they have, but this was a spectacular rendition of what a chocolate cake can be.

I had a little coffee to accompany and they paired well in my opinion.

I have to say I was not particularly impressed by the speed or the service. By bill never arrived, after asking for it a couple times, and then I had to wait for ages inside.

It’s a nice place, they have good cakes, but don’t expect to be paid much attention.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDP2ovkjwE&fid=0x0:0xa99fe1b8237211f6"],"When":"2024-12-1"},{"Name":"Aleksandar Sandic","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVvMkPg7uI9DYI-7VvEP8vziRTXD9MPZiMHU5MdlNcuv2Kh-WoN3g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Nice meat dishes. Service is great, place is a cute comfort, I went back twice!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCEPl_wr68otONQPcpyw7a5&fid=0x0:0x42fc5933e0060762"],"When":"2025-9-11"},{"Name":"Malika OS","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIQU7aSTqJIoMqTcyv8wEwq_htiTsXYLA_nYp3mojUuS5s6IVWE=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"That’s a really cool place, the atmosphere is nice and the decoration is beautiful & the big teddy bears at the front are so cute !
The service was outstanding and the food was tasty, only for my egg Benedict the portion was a bit small for me.
The waitress was very professional and fast but we think it’s better they have someone else get payments because my husband couldn’t eat his bread as he seen her touch money and then cut bread with bare hand without washing them …
Overall it is a nice spot with very good quality food, the food lift is so cool too!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgMDokI-J3AE&fid=0x0:0x42fc5933e0060762"],"When":"2025-4-21"},{"Name":"noora patel","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIhmf-C6RT-w2wfQvEUDHI8CO6Kl0FbtBzpFLCYHZaCEOgd1BM=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Came here on a whim during my stay in Marrakech, and have been completely obsessed. I’ve probably came back to Lilly Billy during this recent trip about 5-6 times, with my family and solo. The food is fantastic with a menu that encompasses both traditional Moroccan food and French cuisine. The interior of the restaurant is beyond gorgeous, everything is well curated in terms of design. The staff are complete amazing and always remember me and treat me and my family with the utmost respect. Also the owner is such a sweet and genuine person, she’s such a sweetheart. Will definitely miss this place once I leave Marrakesh, but will definitely be referring this place to everyone I know. Thank you Lilly Billy, for making this trip so much more enjoyable","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"mohammed alahmed","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW9q0r0XtVIZ1ac2sGAXhaR4yJKX4KrtcqIqRrso8ku9lbXUm0=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Lili Billy offers a truly refined dining experience that beautifully blends warm ambiance with thoughtful cuisine. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels welcoming yet sophisticated, making it ideal for both casual dining and special occasions.

The service was attentive and professional, with staff who clearly take pride in their work and in ensuring guests feel comfortable and well cared for. The food was carefully prepared, fresh, and well-balanced in flavor, reflecting both creativity and respect for quality ingredients.

What stands out most about Lili Billy is the attention to detail — not only in the dishes but in the overall experience, from presentation to hospitality. It’s a place where you feel valued as a guest, not just another customer.

I would happily return and recommend Lili Billy to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience in a stylish and relaxed setting.

[{"Name":"Gary Steck","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKIIVefV9Yl8YUdOchrFqMzdmApnYr3ltETQ03gTd0LEf2KGg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We found this pearl by chance thru the great reviews and wanting a more modern cuisine for the night. This place got the spot on all accounts.
The food was fresh, prepared perfectly and the presentation was on the spot. The interior design of the restaurant was also super cool with all kind of pop art decor and eclectic design. The bathroom in itself was worth the visit.
The service was very friendly, professional and efficient. The meal came with an extra tea and cordial at the end and the owner was so kind to help us flag down a taxi.
Definitely worth to get out of your way and see the "other, modern" Marrakesh!
Love it and we hope we can come back and visit again. Love the team at La Palette and all the best!!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDM-xvzOGcjkadKeC-pCF2W&fid=0x0:0xd67a343c5febc309"],"When":"2025-9-9"},{"Name":"Neil Harris","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJKB9y2dC6qK93wTmtcS_3FTgIYRfeIxgq8ZrOShDE9c8mI8A=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Went tonight with the family.  What a find!  One of the best menus we’ve sampled outside of a Michelin starred restaurant.  Almost impossible to choose a dish.  Quality was superb and service to match- efficient and friendly without being intrusive.  Worth travelling across town for (although we were round the corner).   Should be on your top 5 list for Marrakech.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Diana Hanss","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLQzxAxMcGG19Lwf4arBRl9YH_sGdWLvCgR2fEoRLdB4R-dhw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Ah the food was wonderful! And the service outstanding.  The cheesecake was not a disappointment, we really enjoyed this restaurant. I  recommend!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhDic82RQwbFl-FvHKzJHdU0&fid=0x0:0xd67a343c5febc309"],"When":"2025-10-6"},{"Name":"R Kim","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLiLp8ZY6-9n29qkL8nF7ZSACU9VHrfY_frHiZCzvVxdhPAWw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"It was our last day in Morocco and our last meal was at Marrakesh's La Palette. We read the reviews and had very high expectations. We had an early wake up the next morning and as such made reservations for the first time slot. Our first impressions were that we had made the right decision. The decor was contemporary with a warm appeal. We were the first to arrive and were greeted warmly. Even the feline representative said hello (although he became a bit of a nuisance when our mains arrived).

We started with warm baguette slices and the octopus app. The octopus was hands down the high light of the night. Delicate in every way with the only issue being my wife... she didn't seem to want to share.

Our mains were the lamb shank and the the whole monk fish. Both were well presented but both were over seasoned and put a damper on what could have been a perfect night.

As the night went on we noticed that there was no one else in the restaurant?? It was almost 7:30pm and still not a sole.

In the end, we had mixed feelings about our meal. One would think that being the only table, extra care should have been taken. However the service was excellent as was the atmosphere. With so many options in Marrakesh, I hope La Palette can up its game for future diners.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDX__fBvQE&fid=0x0:0xd67a343c5febc309"],"When":"2024-11-1"},{"Name":"Ashley Gilbert","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXvXGC849XdBoKCQngqG9SsVq_IoqSN4bfSFWNKC7CWdg_Kf7yg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Popped in for an early drink and snacks. Best food In Marrakech","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCh3_XWMkDw1VqvKkLxMlQ1&fid=0x0:0xd67a343c5febc309"],"When":"2025-9-1"},{"Name":"Eric Le Roux","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXto_kYqM3p5Dfs_CrN7XNG_vILpyjQJFWWl_yYvcyZGAQ5nkJi=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Very nice restaurant, quality cocktails and dishes in a cosy atmosphere. The staff does a good job but they seem to be constantly under scrutiny so interactions are sometimes a little awkward. Might be related to language barrier but it'd definitely be a 5 stars if the staff could be a little more relaxed. Recommended.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIHM0ogKEICAgIDh44_CFg&fid=0x0:0xd67a343c5febc309"],"When":"2023-3-16"},{"Name":"Jon Robinson","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKRqXrHlnmVNdvHocf43fsLKztFLZSI1TF5g8rytdXfWcm1uxw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We were walking around in the area and happened to pull this place up on Google. Really glad we did. The food was exceptional. I had the duck, which was the best presentation and most flavorful duck I’ve had — and it’s one of my favorite meats. The staff were very friendly and kind, helping to accommodate our 3 year old daughter. The restaurant was packed and lively with a really cool decor. Ee we’re lucky to grab the last table without a reservation. Overall I highly recommend it!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Gerhard H.","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKS2ZQbJnQz0-SWjhyH9e-tsoxa_LwxbgkMmuucgm-7MvxXSQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Great restaurant, superb food, good vibe. [{"Name":"Carlotta Audain","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUV6oN_2e6KBN1klkSTYpgst0KHNwpoEANy5tQIx6ucIrkPI6s=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Today is our last night in Marrakech. We were just searching google maps for somewhere to have our final meal and we came across this place. I am so happy we did. This is the best meal we have had in Marrakech. Fantastic food, beautiful ambience and superb service. There is nothing we did not enjoy. We both had the lamb shanks tagine and we had the vegetarian couscous. What a great way to end our time in Marrakech.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBunZuaUaTKg7qEm-WM7J7d&fid=0x0:0xe3ee32ffd1caf7a4"],"When":"2025-10-24"},{"Name":"Aryan Márquez","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVX-ue7cwTOrPx7dOnzSChVncDPki7-Ht-3uWEGa9zEfiBiMg7vJg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This place Is not only aestheticly beautiful but also delicious. They serve traditional dishes, and all we tried was delicious. Mustapha was our server and he went above and beyond to give us the best experience ever. One of the best places we visited in Marrakech. Try the meatball tajine!","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBVA49Zg51gpSzAziiyWkSE&fid=0x0:0xe3ee32ffd1caf7a4"],"When":"2026-2-9"},{"Name":"Dan R. Deneyer","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXYtl8rO9TcBn-vonpNx68xIpX46vsOJ2mw93krtHfJpl4Nm4rm=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Right beside the Ari Hotel, this charming spot serves Moroccan dishes with a touch of flare and finesse, all in a fresh, tastefully decorated dining room. I ordered a chicken pastry that was nothing short of delightful - honey, almonds, cumin, pistachios, all dancing together like they’d rehearsed for weeks. The freshly squeezed orange juice was just as impressive, bright and fragrant.

Service was friendly and flawless, and the final bill landed softly, without any unpleasant surprises.

A lovely little gem - unexpected, refined, and very much worth a visit.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhAjqLhjYzgfdZl7FlbhHXZB&fid=0x0:0xe3ee32ffd1caf7a4"],"When":"2025-11-15"},{"Name":"Joe Plewes","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJg0tlKY4jPzOPgUgouYzu_U5YrYOMHu6EIwUEQ8e42qDQVmA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Yeah I enjoyed this, basically looking for somewhere close to my hotel late evening. The chicken Pastilla with almonds was 5/5, I enjoyed the Tanjia de Marrakech but I've had slightly more rich flavours and more of an experience with this dish in the Medina to be honest.  Nice warm bread was welcome and the service from Mustapha was 5/5.

Downside, bit quiet and not much atmosphere, I did eat late but basically packing up so I felt a bit bad staying! The quality was good though.

There were good vegan and veggie options on the menu if that is something you're looking for.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhBfgZp5bxiDCKHaWik5co-T&fid=0x0:0xe3ee32ffd1caf7a4"],"When":"2026-1-10"},{"Name":"Max S","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUacaQvBP-rEr0WplzOPvOID82IZJSnHbCuBUqEtEZZI3DKkrf3Ew=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Absolutely amazing lamb shoulder tagine. By far the best we had in Morocco.
Incredible dressing/sauce and meat itself.
Top notch service from Mustafa truly felt like 5* hotel and Michelin restaurant.","Images":["www.google.com/local/imagery/report/?cb_client=maps_sv.tactile&image_key=!1e10!2sCIABIhCD3g3vFAo3OPJAFEb4bMWm&fid=0x0:0xe3ee32ffd1caf7a4"],"When":"2026-2-2"},{"Name":"Lindsay Kowallek","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJRhgoehRWRCOblFPgYNZAyjRdSqnbE5xQ_gn61zyBuS9dgzw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"The food here was really good and the restaurant is really nice but sadly the service was lacking.
